entities.summary: Asim Mujkić is a Bosnian philosopher and sociologist. Educated at the University of Sarajevo, he works in the areas of ethics, phenomenology, philosophy of existence, philosophy of identity, social and political theory and theories on ethnicity. He has written particularly extensively on ethnicity and identity, ethnic phenomenology, existentialism, and on the works and thought of Richard Rorty and John Rawls. He is a professor at the University of Sarajevo. Asim Mujkić was a philosophers & thinkers from Brčko (b. 1968-05-11, Brčko). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
